description.value: Panago Pizza is a Canadian pizza chain with a Nanaimo location offering delivery and online ordering. The brand emphasizes Canadian-sourced ingredients including 100% Canadian wheat dough made fresh in-house and organic tomato sauce. Touring cyclists will find a broad menu including pizzas, salads, sides, and plant-based options.
